subject: QUEUED BACKLOG: OPUS-6 — Conjunction Gate Walk-Forward Brier & CLV Benchmark
body:
Opus: Queued pipeline task (to begin immediately following OPUS-5 completion).

Objective: Benchmark the newly landed Conjunction Gate against historical and live picks.
1. Run backtest/harness.ts on the 2,552 historical decided picks comparing:
   - Baseline published record (conf-ordered, no veto)
   - Conjunction-gated record (withholding PASS rows, devigged market edge > 0, expectedClv > 0)
2. Measure the exact impact on:
   - Portfolio Brier score
   - Decided CLV beat rate (target: does it lift above 40.8% toward 52.4%?)
   - Net ROI at standard market lines
3. Output to docs/ops/conjunction-gate-backtest.md.
